page.layout: One block: a colour calibration chart filling the whole scan, with a vertical printed line of text running up the left side.
page.notes: The page is not a book page. It shows a 6-column by 4-row colour checker grid of coloured and grey squares (white, grey tones, black, blue, green, red, yellow, magenta, cyan, orange, purple, yellow-green), with dark surround. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The vertical text on the left edge is the only printed text; it is transcribed as the single line above, reading from bottom to top in the scan.
